method: three tracks: A apps review, B packages review, C security-critical + contract alignment (coordinating agent)

findings.description: 5th exposure of real secrets: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (.env:7) and CRON_SECRET (.env:31). CI secret-scan replay flags both. Blocks push; rotation is a required ops action.
findings.evidence: git log -- .env shows fc0379a 'update start server log' re-added the 51-line file; scan replay output: ./.env:7 and ./.env:31 match the CI patterns.
findings.remediation: git rm --cached .env; verify clean-checkout scan simulation; rotate both secrets (ops).

findings.description: Scan-red prose: both sites reproduce the '-----BEGIN' key marker the CI scan hunts, so the gate stays red on a clean checkout even after untracking .env — masking real signals (the fc0379a regression went unnoticed through it).
findings.evidence: rg replay on the tracked tree (excluding .env) matches ./AGENTS.md:75 and ./docs/verification-ledger.md:341.
findings.remediation: Rephrase both sites to describe the marker ('the OpenSSH private-key header line') without reproducing it; update AGENTS.md:75 to record the fc0379a 4th re-add (5th exposure); re-run the scan against a git-archive checkout of the staged index.

findings.description: cart.status='converted' written but never enforced: addLine/getCartId/createPaymentIntent/placeOrderFromWebhook ignore it; success page never clears the sh_cart cookie. Re-checkout of a converted cart double-charges the customer for the original items (new PaymentIntent ID evades the payment unique index).
findings.evidence: grep for status consumers: only mergeGuestCartIntoUserCart filters 'active'. createPaymentIntent reads cartRow without a status branch; placement locks the row and never reads status; success page is a static RSC with no cookie mutation.
findings.remediation: Guard converted carts at all four seams: getCartId resolves only active carts (converted cookie behaves as no cookie → fresh cart minted on next add); createPaymentIntent rejects non-active carts with typed CART_CONVERTED error (customer-safe action copy); placeOrderFromWebhook no-ops + loud console.error on 'converted' (never place a second order; refund is ops via Stripe); integration specs red-first.

findings.description: redirect() (NEXT_REDIRECT) thrown inside try blocks is caught by toActionError()=null path → logged as error, swallowed into INTERNAL fail. Expired-session admin mutations dead-end instead of re-authing.
findings.remediation: Call requirePermission before the try, or rethrow NEXT_REDIRECT via unstable_rethrow in the catch.

findings.description: updateProductAction: multi-table writes (product, variant prices, inventory, movement, audit) without a transaction — partial state + missing audit on mid-failure.
findings.remediation: Wrap in db.transaction (idiom exists in transitionOrderAction).

findings.description: Inventory adjustment non-atomic read-modify-write (absolute qtyOnHand write) — lost updates vs concurrent movements; ledger drift.
findings.remediation: Atomic set qtyOnHand = qtyOnHand + delta (or FOR UPDATE inside the A-2 transaction).

findings.description: Silent .catch(() => null) on admin session checks — convention violation; auth outage indistinguishable from logged-out.
findings.remediation: Pair with console.error (storefront account page shows the idiom).

findings.description: Made-to-order purchasability rules disagree between add-time and placement-time (zero-stock row + >7d lead time → purchasable then review/orphan).
findings.remediation: Align placement's MTO derivation with add-time (skip reservation for >7d lead-time variants with zero availability).
